bio.text: Ann Wagner represents Missouri's 2nd Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives, having taken office in January 2013, and serves on the House Financial Services Committee and the Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence.
She was sworn in as U.S. Ambassador to Luxembourg in 2005 and served four years, and earlier chaired the Missouri Republican Party and served as Co-Chairman of the Republican National Committee.
She holds a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration from the University of Missouri-Columbia, and held management positions at Hallmark Cards and Ralston Purina.
